lines.zh: 我贴着礁石缝游，牙先探路。
lines.en: I swim along the reef crack, teeth scouting ahead.

lines.zh: 水流一推，我就顺着力滑过去。
lines.en: One push of current and I slide along with it.

lines.zh: 这截水道窄，我的牙总刮到边。
lines.en: This channel is narrow; my teeth keep scraping the sides.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我钻进珊瑚的影子里。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I slip into the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 我绕着同一块礁石转第三圈了。
lines.en: I have circled the same reef rock three times now.

lines.zh: 游得再快，牙还是露在水面上。
lines.en: No matter how fast I swim, my teeth still break the surface.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流走，那里虫子多。
lines.en: I follow the warm current, where the small bugs gather.

lines.zh: 石缝里太暗，我只能用牙探。
lines.en: The crevice is too dark; I can only feel with my teeth.

lines.zh: 水面上的光一晃，我就沉下去。
lines.en: When the light above flickers, I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑，尽量不扬泥。
lines.en: I skim the sandy floor, trying not to stir silt.

lines.zh: 整群鱼一起转身，水都变白了。
lines.en: The whole school turns at once and the water whitens.

lines.zh: 我的鳍太薄，划开水面像刀。
lines.en: My fins are so thin they cut the water like blades.

lines.zh: 礁齿鱼只在水里活，上岸就是死。
lines.en: A reeftooth lives only in water; on land I am dead.

lines.zh: 我跟着气泡走，气泡那边是浅滩。
lines.en: I follow the bubbles; beyond them lies the shallows.

lines.zh: 我从礁洞钻出去，牙先露出来。
lines.en: I slip from the reef hole, teeth first.

lines.zh: 我顺着水道游，鳍擦着沙。
lines.en: I follow the channel, fins brushing sand.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，牙齿一张一合。
lines.en: I hang in the water, teeth opening and closing.

lines.zh: 没动静，我就数礁石上的洞。
lines.en: Nothing stirs, so I count the holes in the reef.

lines.zh: 两颗心的身板，安静最省力气。
lines.en: With two hearts of body, stillness saves the most strength.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，再慢慢合上。
lines.en: I open my mouth wide, then slowly close it.

lines.zh: 水流过鳃，我什么也不想。
lines.en: Water passes my gills and I think of nothing.

lines.zh: 那块珊瑚上有条虫，我盯着它。
lines.en: There is a worm on that coral; I keep watching it.

lines.zh: 我守在石缝口，等小鱼自己送上来。
lines.en: I guard the crevice mouth, waiting for small fish to drift in.

lines.zh: 牙齿一直露着，其实我在打盹。
lines.en: My teeth stay bared, though I am actually dozing.

lines.zh: 这片水域太浅，藏不住我。
lines.en: This stretch is too shallow to hide me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地摆尾，只为不沉底。
lines.en: I flick my tail slowly, only to keep from sinking.

lines.zh: 听见远处落水声，我愣了一下。
lines.en: Hearing a distant splash, I freeze for a moment.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把食物带过来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the tide to bring food over.

lines.zh: 静下来才听得出礁石在响。
lines.en: Only in silence can I hear the reef humming.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口水草，味道不对。
lines.en: I bite the weed; the taste is wrong.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我只看你的倒影。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; I only watch your reflection.

lines.zh: 你一动，水就替你报了位置。
lines.en: When you move, the water reports where you are.

lines.zh: 那块木头后面有两只眼睛，是你吧。
lines.en: Two eyes behind that log — that would be you.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，牙先露出水面。
lines.en: I raise my head and my teeth break the surface first.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，我的鳃就紧了。
lines.en: When you step into the shallows, my gills tighten.

lines.zh: 我认得你的影子，比礁石高太多。
lines.en: I know your shadow; it is far taller than the reef.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在滴水，我听见了。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is dripping; I hear it.

lines.zh: 别蹲下，蹲下你就更像捕食者。
lines.en: Do not crouch; crouching makes you look more like a hunter.

lines.zh: 我从水下看你的脸，全变形了。
lines.en: From underwater your face is completely warped.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手，我就先钻石缝。
lines.en: If you reach in, I will be in the crevice first.

lines.zh: 这一下让我往石缝里缩。
lines.en: This blow makes me shrink into the crevice.

lines.zh: 鳞片翻了，水一碰就疼。
lines.en: My scales are torn, and the water stings them.

lines.zh: 我只有两心，经不起第二下。
lines.en: I have only two hearts; I cannot take a second hit.

lines.zh: 牙断了一颗，我尝到自己的血。
lines.en: A tooth broke and I taste my own blood.

lines.zh: 疼得我撞上了礁壁。
lines.en: The pain drove me into the reef wall.

lines.zh: 别打了，我游不过你的手。
lines.en: Stop hitting; I cannot outswim your hand.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在抖，稳不住身子。
lines.en: My fins tremble and I cannot hold steady.

lines.zh: 这一道口子，要好几天才长好。
lines.en: A gash like this takes days to close.

lines.zh: 我掉了一片鳞，水都变红了。
lines.en: A scale came off and the water turned red.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我只想往深处去。
lines.en: After the pain, I only want to go deeper.

lines.zh: 水里有虫在动，我绕着它转。
lines.en: Something wriggles in the water and I circle it.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑，我一口一口捡。
lines.en: I pick up the crumbs you scatter, one by one.

lines.zh: 那团红的东西像虫，我靠近点。
lines.en: That red lump looks like a bug; I move closer.

lines.zh: 气味顺着水来，我的牙抖了。
lines.en: The smell comes with the current and my teeth twitch.

lines.zh: 我绕着你抛的饵转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half a turn around the bait you cast.

lines.zh: 只要它还在动，我就还想咬。
lines.en: As long as it still moves, I still want to bite it.

lines.zh: 这条水道的香味不对，太好闻了。
lines.en: This channel smells wrong — far too good.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了一下，又吐出来。
lines.en: I try a mouthful, then spit it back out.

lines.zh: 饵沉到石缝里，我钻进去够。
lines.en: The bait sinks into the crevice and I squeeze in after it.

lines.zh: 我明明不饿，牙还是自己动了。
lines.en: I am not hungry, yet my teeth move on their own.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，鳞片掉了一片。
lines.en: You bumped me and a scale came loose.

lines.zh: 别推，我身后就是石头。
lines.en: Do not push; there is stone right behind me.

lines.zh: 我被挤得贴住礁壁，动不了。
lines.en: I am pressed flat against the reef wall, unable to move.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进我的水道了。
lines.en: Your boot has stepped into my channel.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，我整条鱼翻了过来。
lines.en: That bump flipped my whole body over.

lines.zh: 我牙磕到你腿上，自己也疼。
lines.en: My teeth knocked your leg, and it hurt me too.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，我找不到方向。
lines.en: The water muddies and I lose my sense of direction.

lines.zh: 别用网，网线会刮掉我的牙。
lines.en: Not the net; its cords will scrape off my teeth.

lines.zh: 我退开半个尾巴的距离。
lines.en: I back off by half a tail's length.

lines.zh: 你又碰到了，这已经第二次。
lines.en: You touched me again; that is the second time.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我们成对地游。
lines.en: In warm spring water we swim in pairs.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转圈，牙都收了起来。
lines.en: I circle my partner with my teeth drawn in.

lines.zh: 石缝深处有片沙，适合放卵。
lines.en: Deep in the crevice there is sand fit for eggs.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着礁壁游过去。
lines.en: We swim past side by side, hugging the reef.

lines.zh: 它的鳍碰到我的鳍，我没躲。
lines.en: Its fin touched mine and I did not flinch away.

lines.zh: 整群鱼都跟着我们转起来了。
lines.en: The whole school has started turning along with us.

lines.zh: 我守着那片卵，谁也不许靠近。
lines.en: I guard that clutch of eggs; no one may come near.

lines.zh: 它的牙比我的短，颜色更浅。
lines.en: Its teeth are shorter than mine and paler.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，穿过同一道石缝。
lines.en: We pass through the same crevice, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 水一变冷，它就游走了。
lines.en: When the water turned cold, it swam away.

lines.zh: 我把那块亮石头含在嘴里。
lines.en: I hold that bright stone in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我只有两颗心，拖不动。
lines.en: I've only two hearts — can't drag it.

lines.zh: 我咬着它游了三格，掉了。
lines.en: I carried it three blocks, then dropped it.

lines.zh: 你掉的碎屑，我捡走当存粮。
lines.en: I take the crumbs you dropped as stored food.

lines.zh: 牙缝卡住了，我得用石头磨。
lines.en: It is stuck in my teeth; I need a stone to grind it.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏在珊瑚底下。
lines.en: I hide the thing beneath the coral.

lines.zh: 这不是吃的，我闻出来了。
lines.en: This is not food; I can smell that much.

lines.zh: 我试着把它顶到石缝里。
lines.en: I try to wedge it into the crevice.

lines.zh: 它一进水就沉，我追着往下。
lines.en: It sinks as soon as it hits water, and I dive after it.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，游得很慢。
lines.en: My mouth is full, so I swim very slowly.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the sound of you wading.

lines.zh: 那条影子在水面停了太久。
lines.en: That shadow has rested on the surface too long.

lines.zh: 有东西在岸边喘气，我游过去。
lines.en: Something is breathing on the bank; I swim over.

lines.zh: 我的牙开始往外顶，忍不住。
lines.en: My teeth start pushing outward and I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 你身上的血味比水腥更冲。
lines.en: The blood smell on you is sharper than the water's.

lines.zh: 我先绕到你背后那道石缝。
lines.en: I circle around to the crevice behind you first.

lines.zh: 这一片水域，只容一个捕食者。
lines.en: This stretch of water holds only one hunter.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的动作，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see your bending motion very clearly.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，别以为我在晒太阳。
lines.en: I have picked you; do not think I am sunning.

lines.zh: 水面一裂，那就是我来了。
lines.en: The surface splits — that is me arriving.

lines.zh: 水一浑，你就抓不到我了。
lines.en: Muddy the water and you can't catch me.

lines.zh: 你脚踝一动，我就跟上半尺。
lines.en: One twitch of your ankle, and I close half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的牙对着你的膝盖高度。
lines.en: My teeth are level with your knees.

lines.zh: 别往深水走，那里我更快。
lines.en: Do not head for deep water; I am faster there.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩空那块滑石。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to slip on that wet stone.

lines.zh: 你转身时，水会先告诉我。
lines.en: When you turn, the water will tell me first.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚下的影子游。
lines.en: I swim along the shadow beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我等它落下。
lines.en: You are holding something up; I wait for it to fall.

lines.zh: 这条水道只有两个出口。
lines.en: This channel has only two ways out.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一弯，我就要窜出去。
lines.en: My tail fin curls; I am about to dart out.

lines.zh: 牙咬进靴子，我往后一扯。
lines.en: My teeth sink into your boot and I wrench backward.

lines.zh: 这一口是冲你的脚踝来的。
lines.en: This bite was aimed at your ankle.

lines.zh: 我撞你的小腿，再咬一口。
lines.en: I ram your shin, then bite.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我看不见你了。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and I lose sight of you.

lines.zh: 你踢过来，我顺势咬住鞋带。
lines.en: You kick; I catch the lace in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，礁石会挡住你。
lines.en: I bite then retreat; the reef will block you.

lines.zh: 别小看这口牙，它连壳都咬。
lines.en: Do not dismiss these teeth; they crack shells.

lines.zh: 我从水下往上冲，专咬腿弯。
lines.en: I rush up from below, aiming at the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 你流血了，水里的味道全变了。
lines.en: You are bleeding; the taste of the water has changed.

lines.zh: 我又咬了一口，这次更深。
lines.en: I bite again, and deeper this time.

lines.zh: 潮水退到石缝线，我跟着来了。
lines.en: The tide dropped to the rock seam, and I came with it.

lines.zh: 水刚漫过石缝，我就来了。
lines.en: The water had barely filled the crevice when I arrived.

lines.zh: 这一片浅水，还没有别的鱼。
lines.en: This patch of shallows has no other fish yet.

lines.zh: 我生在石缝里，牙先长出来。
lines.en: I was born in a crevice; my teeth grew first.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推进了这条水道。
lines.en: The tide pushed me into this channel.

lines.zh: 我第一次浮上水面，光很刺眼。
lines.en: My first time at the surface; the light stings.

lines.zh: 整群鱼一起出现，水都挤满了。
lines.en: The whole school appears at once and the water is packed.

lines.zh: 我闻到新水域的味道，就留下了。
lines.en: I smelled a new stretch of water and stayed.

lines.zh: 我太小了，礁石都比我高。
lines.en: I am so small the reef rocks tower over me.

lines.zh: 刚出生的鱼，牙却已经很尖。
lines.en: Newly born, yet my teeth are already sharp.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，我的鳃在烫。
lines.en: The water is boiling hot and my gills burn.

lines.zh: 落在石头上，我弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit the stone and bounce once.

lines.zh: 我本来在水里，可这水没有气。
lines.en: I live in water, yet this water has no air.

lines.zh: 气浪把我拍在礁石上。
lines.en: The blast slams me against the reef.

lines.zh: 那根细东西穿过了我的鳍。
lines.en: That thin thing went straight through my fin.

lines.zh: 这味道让我的牙发麻。
lines.en: This smell makes my teeth go numb.

lines.zh: 水里没有虫，我饿得发飘。
lines.en: No bugs in the water; hunger makes me drift.

lines.zh: 水里导电，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: Water carries the current; my whole body went numb.

lines.zh: 干得发裂，我的鳃贴成一片。
lines.en: Dry to the cracks; my gills are stuck shut.
